seo.title: Patagonia and Chilean Fjords by Antarctica21
seo.description: Sail the Chilean fjords between Puerto Montt and Ushuaia: Pio XI Glacier, Caleta Tortel, Bernardo O'Higgins National Park and Glacier Alley. Nine or eleven days.

tagline: The fjords between Puerto Montt and Ushuaia.
answer: Patagonia and Chilean Fjords is Antarctica21's one way sea voyage between Puerto Montt, Chile, and Ushuaia, Argentina, run in both directions. The 2026-27 version is nine days and eight nights; 2027-28 is eleven days and ten nights and adds Madre de Dios Island and Torres del Paine. It sails in September and April with up to 96 guests.
overview: The repositioning voyages that bring the ships south in spring and north in autumn, through the channels, glaciers and stilt villages of Chilean Patagonia.

itineraryNote: Nine day southbound (2026-27) shown. Antarctica21 also publishes a nine day northbound and eleven day southbound and northbound versions (2027-28: Kent Island, Madre de Dios Island, Las Montañas Channel, a Torres del Paine bus excursion, Seno de Agostini and Yendegaia National Park).
inclusions: Guided shore excursions, lectures and onboard entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch, a la carte dinner, selected drinks and snacks

children: Sea voyages: minimum age 12, per Antarctica21's travel tips FAQ.
faqs: Does this voyage go to Antarctica?
No. It sails the Chilean fjords between Puerto Montt and Ushuaia.
Nine days in 2026-27 and eleven days in 2027-28, in either direction.
